title: Jimothy Jamothy
author: DuchessCupcakeGames
selftext: Vote for me!!! I made a have called Jimothy's Journey, you may have seen it here, but it's really fun and I worked on it just for this contest! Play My game, follow the link and leave a comment, your support is much appreciated! This is by far one of my favorite games I've made so far with Claude, Codex and Lovable. Yeah some animations are wonky, but I stand by the game play and questlines I created myself. It's 100%Free to play, no paywalls no ads, (ibut I may have snuck in a few plugs for my other free games  with a quest or two!)
